askpass.title: AuraPi — Root privileges
askpass.heading: AuraPi requires root privileges
askpass.message: Enter your user password (valid for the entire session; no repeated prompt required):

devices.note: Only devices with a serial number and stable by-id identifier are shown.
devices.none_verified: No verified removable drives found. Note: devices without a serial number/by-id path are hidden for safety reasons.
devices.show_more_tooltip: Also shows drives without a serial number or a stable by-id path (e.g. exotic USB adapters). These cannot be re-verified before writing with the same confidence as other devices - only enable this if you are absolutely sure which device is selected.

tooltips.rpi: Maximum shrinking with PiShrink. Suitable only for layouts with a FAT boot partition and an ext4 root partition (standard Raspberry Pi OS). Other layouts are rejected safely.
tooltips.other: Copies all partitions unchanged up to the end of the last partition. Filesystem-independent, but not suitable for every boot/partition layout. Not available for GPT drives because the backup GPT at the end of the device would be missing.
tooltips.full: Copies the entire card 1:1, including unused space. Works with every layout, including GPT, UBI/UBIFS and special bootloaders. Largest file, but the safest choice for unknown or exotic systems.

pishrink.not_verified: ✗ PiShrink not verified ({info}) — see installation instructions.
pishrink.install_hint:
PiShrink is not installed or cannot be verified.

Manual installation of the CHECKED, pinned version:

  curl -fsSL \
    https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Drewsif/PiShrink/{commit}/pishrink.sh \
    -o /tmp/pishrink.sh
  sha256sum /tmp/pishrink.sh
  # must match exactly: {sha256}
  sudo install -o root -g root -m 755 /tmp/pishrink.sh {path}

Then click "Check again" in AuraPi.
